tracking_id.title: A unique identifier for the float payment

status.title: Current float payment status
status.description:
It only accepts the following values:

`CREATED`: When the float payment request is created.

`UNSETTLED`: When the float payment has unsettled values.

`SETTLED`:When the float payment has been paid in full.

`FAILED`: When an error occurred.

settlement_date.title: Settlement Date
settlement_date.description: Corresponds to the cycle closing date relative to the payment date

division_code.title: Division Code
division_code.description: Unique code that identifies the division within your organization.
